title: Coolie
description: Rajinikanth stars in this high-octane action thriller directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj. A gripping storyline with breathtaking action sequences set in a pan-India backdrop.

reviews.name: Ashwin
reviews.comment: Pure mass! The BGM is lit.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
description: A mythological sci-fi epic blending the world of Kalki with a futuristic dystopia. Starring Prabhas, Deepika Padukone, and Amitabh Bachchan in iconic roles.

reviews.name: Meera
reviews.comment: Visually stunning! A cinematic masterpiece.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
description: Allu Arjun returns as Pushpa Raj in the explosive sequel. The red sandalwood smuggler faces even deadlier enemies as he battles to rule the underworld.

reviews.name: Ravi
reviews.comment: Flower, but not so simple! Allu Arjun is phenomenal.

title: RRR Reloaded
description: A director's cut re-release of the global blockbuster RRR with 20 minutes of never-before-seen footage. Experience the epic saga of Raju and Bheem in a new light.

reviews.name: Priya
reviews.comment: Best Indian film ever made. Naatu Naatu forever!

title: KGF Chapter 3
description: Rocky's legacy continues in this explosive third installment. The saga of the Kolar Gold Fields and the rise of an empire reaches its ultimate conclusion.

reviews.name: Sanjay
reviews.comment: Rocky bhai is back and bigger than ever!

title: Jawan Remastered
description: Shah Rukh Khan's blockbuster returns in a remastered version with enhanced visuals and sound. Relive the action-thriller that broke box-office records across India.

reviews.name: Akash
reviews.comment: Still as gripping as day one. SRK is unstoppable!

title: Dunki Return
description: A heartwarming sequel to Dunki where Hardy and his friends navigate new adventures in their quest for a better life. Laughter, drama, and emotion in equal measure.

reviews.name: Kavitha
reviews.comment: Heartwarming and hilarious from start to finish.

title: Singham Again 2
description: The Rohit Shetty cop universe expands in this explosive sequel with Singham leading a team of elite officers to take down a massive crime syndicate.

reviews.name: Deepak
reviews.comment: Full on masala entertainment! Cars flying everywhere.

title: Leo 2
description: Thalapathy Vijay is back in the sequel to Leo, continuing the dark and intense narrative of a man running from his past while protecting those he loves.

reviews.name: Balaji
reviews.comment: Thalapathy in beast mode. The interval block is insane!

title: Adipurush Extended Cut
description: The epic mythological drama Adipurush returns in an extended director's cut with reimagined VFX sequences and 30 minutes of additional footage.

reviews.name: Siri
reviews.comment: The extended version truly redeems the theatrical experience.

title: Bigg Boss OTT Live Grand Finale
location: Nehru Indoor Stadium, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
description: Watch the live grand finale of Bigg Boss OTT with celebrity guests, surprise acts, and the crowning of the winner. An unforgettable evening of drama and entertainment.

reviews.name: Preetha
reviews.comment: Being in the studio audience was a dream come true!

title: India's Got Talent Grand Finale
location: HITEX Exhibition Centre, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh
description: The grand finale of India's biggest talent hunt show. Watch extraordinary acts compete for the coveted title and a life-changing prize money.

reviews.name: Mohan
reviews.comment: Every act left me speechless. True talent on display!

title: Dance India Dance Finals
description: The most celebrated dance reality show comes to its final showdown. Watch India's top dancers battle it out in spectacular choreographic performances.

reviews.name: Lakshmi
reviews.comment: The energy in the venue was electric!

title: Kaun Banega Crorepati Live
description: A special live stage adaptation of KBC hosted by the legendary Amitabh Bachchan. Audience members can participate and win exciting prizes.

reviews.name: Venkat
reviews.comment: Seeing Big B live was a surreal experience. Absolutely worth it!

title: The Kapil Sharma Show Live
description: An exclusive live taping of The Kapil Sharma Show with celebrity guests and unpredictable comedy sketches. Experience the magic of India's favourite comedy talk show.

reviews.name: Sunita
reviews.comment: Non-stop laughter throughout! Kapil is a genius entertainer.

title: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Grand Finale
description: India's legendary musical reality show reaches its grand finale. Witness breathtaking vocal performances as talented singers compete for the ultimate title.

reviews.name: Anjali
reviews.comment: Each performance was a treat for the soul. Brilliant voices!

title: Superstar Singer Live Finals
description: Child prodigies take the center stage in the grand finale of Superstar Singer. Witness the extraordinary talent of young musical geniuses that will leave you in awe.

reviews.name: Ramesh
reviews.comment: These kids sing better than most adults. Outstanding talent!

title: MasterChef India Live Kitchen Battle
description: A spectacular live culinary event where MasterChef India finalists compete in front of a live audience. Watch as gourmet dishes are crafted in real-time.

reviews.name: Divya
reviews.comment: I tasted the most exquisite food of my life. A heavenly experience!

title: Shark Tank India Live Pitch Event
location: Sawai Man Singh Auditorium, Jaipur, Rajasthan
description: A live edition of Shark Tank India where entrepreneurs pitch to the Sharks for real funding. Network with startup founders and investors in an inspiring atmosphere.

reviews.name: Hari
reviews.comment: The most inspiring event I've ever attended. Changed my perspective!

title: Stand Up India Comedy Special Live
description: A special one-night stand-up comedy showcase featuring 5 of India's top comedians performing exclusive sets. Expect shocking wit, relatable humor, and side-splitting jokes.

reviews.name: Naga
reviews.comment: My cheeks still hurt from laughing. Absolute comedy gold!

title: AR Rahman Live Symphony Tour
location: Nehru Indoor Arena, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
description: The Mozart of Madras returns with a magical symphony of his most iconic soundtracks, accompanied by a 60-piece orchestra. A night of transcendent music.

reviews.name: Nisha
reviews.comment: It felt heavenly! Literal goosebumps throughout the entire show.

title: Anirudh Ravichander World Tour
location: GMC Balayogi Athletic Stadium, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh
description: Experience the musical genius of Anirudh Ravichander in a spectacular live performance featuring all his biggest hits from blockbuster films.

reviews.name: Vikram
reviews.comment: Mind-blowing energy! Best concert I've ever attended in my life.

title: Diljit Dosanjh Dil-Luminati Tour
description: Punjab da puttar Diljit Dosanjh is back with his spectacular Dil-Luminati Tour featuring state-of-the-art stage production, massive LED screens, and incredible energy.

reviews.name: Gurpreet
reviews.comment: The production quality was absolutely world-class. Diljit never disappoints!

title: Arijit Singh Live: An Emotional Journey
description: India's most beloved voice, Arijit Singh, performs his heart-touching catalog live. An evening of pure emotion and musical brilliance that will stay with you forever.

reviews.name: Anjali
reviews.comment: I cried, I danced, I felt everything. The most memorable night of my life.

title: Sunburn Festival Goa Edition
location: Vagator Beach, North Goa (via Rajasthan leg)
description: Asia's biggest Electronic Dance Music festival makes a stop with an exclusive 3-day event featuring Martin Garrix, Alesso, and top Indian DJs.

reviews.name: Rohan
reviews.comment: Absolute banger of a festival. The vibes were out of this world!

title: SPB Tribute Concert
description: A grand tribute concert celebrating the legacy of the legendary S.P. Balasubrahmanyam, featuring top South Indian playback singers performing his timeless classics.

reviews.name: Suresh
reviews.comment: Tears and goosebumps. A fitting tribute to a legend.

title: Coldplay India Tour - Bengaluru Night
location: DY Patil Stadium Bengaluru Venue, Karnataka
description: Coldplay brings their monumental Music of the Spheres World Tour to India. Experience A Sky Full of Stars, Yellow, and all the biggest hits in an immersive LED-lit spectacle.

reviews.name: Preethi
reviews.comment: A transcendent experience. Coldplay redefines what a concert can be.

title: Carnatic Fusion Night
description: A stunning blend of traditional Carnatic classical music with jazz and electronic elements. Featuring award-winning musicians creating a unique fusion soundscape.

reviews.name: Meenakshi
reviews.comment: The fusion was breathtaking. Traditional and modern in perfect harmony.

title: Shreya Ghoshal Melodies Night
description: The nightingale of India, Shreya Ghoshal, performs her most beloved songs from Bollywood and regional cinema in an intimate concert setting.

reviews.name: Rekha
reviews.comment: Her voice is pure magic. Every note touched my heart.

title: Vishal–Shekhar Live Spectacular
description: The iconic Bollywood composer duo Vishal–Shekhar perform their greatest compositions live with a full band. An evening of foot-tapping numbers and melodious hits.

reviews.name: Gaurav
reviews.comment: An evening of non-stop hits. They had the crowd singing along all night!

title: Chennai Music Festival Open Stage
location: Marina Beach Grounds, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
description: An open-air cultural extravaganza featuring folk music, classical performances, street food, and artisan exhibitions along the iconic Marina Beach promenade.

reviews.name: Geetha
reviews.comment: The best way to experience Chennai's culture in one place!

title: Vizag International Film Festival
description: A week-long international film festival showcasing award-winning films from over 50 countries with panel discussions, filmmaker Q&As, and workshops.

reviews.name: Sridhar
reviews.comment: Cinema lovers must attend. The film curation was exceptional.

title: Kerala Boat Race Festival
description: Witness the thrilling Nehru Trophy Boat Race, the most prestigious snake boat race in Kerala. Experience the roar of thousands of oarsmen and the electric atmosphere of this iconic festival.

reviews.name: Thomas
reviews.comment: The snake boat race is absolutely exhilarating! A must-see event.

title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026
description: India's premier technology summit bringing together global tech leaders, startups, and investors. Featuring keynotes, innovation showcases, and networking opportunities.

reviews.name: Kiran
reviews.comment: The most valuable professional investment of the year. Invaluable connections made!

title: Jaipur Literature Festival
description: The world's largest free literary festival returns to the Pink City. Five days of conversations with authors, thinkers, and change-makers from around the globe.

reviews.name: Rashmi
reviews.comment: A paradise for book lovers. World-class speakers in a magnificent setting!

title: Tamil Nadu Harvest Festival Expo
description: Celebrate Pongal with a vibrant cultural expo featuring traditional kolam competitions, Jallikattu demonstrations, organic food markets, and folk art exhibitions.

reviews.name: Murugan
reviews.comment: A beautiful celebration of our roots and Tamil culture.

title: Andhra Food & Culture Mela
location: Indira Gandhi Municipal Stadium, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
description: Celebrate the rich culinary and cultural heritage of Andhra Pradesh with authentic cuisine stalls, Kuchipudi dance performances, and traditional handicraft exhibitions.

reviews.name: Padma
reviews.comment: The gongura pickle competition alone was worth the trip!

title: Kerala Onam Grand Celebration
location: Sree Balaramapuram Cultural Centre, Palakkad, Kerala
description: Celebrate the grand festival of Onam with Pookalam competitions, Thiruvathira dance, Onasadya feast, and the mesmerising Pulikali tiger dance performance.

reviews.name: Anoop
reviews.comment: The Onam celebration here is truly spectacular. Felt the true spirit of Kerala!

title: Mysuru Dasara World Fair
description: The grand Mysuru Dasara celebrations with the famous golden elephant procession, light-up palace, cultural shows, and international trade fair over 10 magnificent days.

reviews.name: Sangeetha
reviews.comment: Mysuru Dasara is truly the festival of festivals. Utterly magnificent!

title: Rajasthan International Folk Festival
description: RIFF brings together folk artists from across India and the world to perform against the stunning backdrop of Mehrangarh Fort. A unique confluence of global folk traditions.

reviews.name: Fatima
reviews.comment: The most magical musical experience against the world's best backdrop!
